source: RMC-BestFit/src/RMC.BestFit/Models/UnivariateDistribution/Bulletin17CDistribution.cs @ c2e6192 (SetDefaultParameters -> ComputeDefaultInitials -> the ROS nonparametric-moment override) and Models/DataFrame/DataFrame.cs @ c2e6192 (SetLowOutliersFromMGBT, GetNonparametricMomentsROS) -- EXACT EMITTER ORACLES dumped from the REAL compiled RMC.BestFit via tools/oracle_emitter and reproduced by tools/verify_oracles.py.
reference: Pins the Bulletin 17C low-outlier path end to end: a record carrying two potentially influential low floods, censored by the PUBLIC SetLowOutliersFromMGBT() frame method, fit by the just-identified LP3 GMM. This is the path that exercises the ROS (regression on order statistics) imputation in ComputeDefaultInitials, which reads each exact ordinate's PLOTTING POSITION. The C# gets those positions from the INotifyPropertyChanged cascade that fires when the low-outlier flags change; this port replaced that plumbing with the explicit-call invalidation contract documented in data_frame.hpp, so models/model_spec.hpp's build_data_frame recomputes them itself after either public low-outlier setter. Before that, a censored frame reached the ROS branch with every plotting position still at its 0.0 default and threw std::out_of_range out of the moment machinery. The parameters asserted here are therefore the direct oracle on that fix: they are the ROS-seeded fit, materially different from the same record fit without censoring (which the sibling gmm_bulletin17c_smoke.json pins). The two frame-state values (number_of_low_outliers 2, low_outlier_threshold 8900) are not asserted here because the GMM target's assertion dispatch has no DataFrame arm (Bulletin17CDistribution is an IGMMModel, not a ModelBase, so it never reaches dispatch_model_data_frame); they are covered by core/tests/test_model_spec_parameters.cpp's sibling suite and the R and Python data-layer tests.

assertions.note: LP3 log-space mean, ROS-seeded. The uncensored fit of the same record lands at 3.9346 (see the reference note), so this value is the direct oracle on the low-outlier path.

LP3 log-space skew. Reproduces to ~1.6e-9 relative, the loosest of the three: it is the parameter the BFGS search is least sharply determined in, and the file policy for optimizer-dependent parameters is rel 1e-8.
